metadata.question: In 2021, did the Antarctic ozone hole reach a size of 18 million square kilometers?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: NASA OMI/Aura ozone total column (OMTO3) → daily, ~0.25°. - Date: 2021, whole year. - Location: South-polar region, e.g. 90°-63°S (commonly used for “ozone-hole” area). 2. Masking strategy - Mask pixels where total O₃ > 220 DU (definition of ozone-hole). - Apply the 220-DU threshold to every daily image → binary mask (1 = hole). - Multiply by pixel area (cos(lat)×0.25×0.25×111 km²) to get km². 3. Logic to distinguish Valid-Zero from Null/Error - After masking, if any day has 0 pixels below 220 DU, hole area is 0 km² (valid zero → A/B). - If reducer returns None/NaN → C3. - If collection size == 0 → C1. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -63]) # Antarctic polar region year = 2021 start, end = f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31' # 2. Data acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMAERUV003'). \ filterDate(start, end).select('ColumnAmountO3'). \ filterBounds(roi) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No OMI images for 2021.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Daily hole-area calculation (km²) def daily_area(img): ozone = img.select('ColumnAmountO3') hole = ozone.lt(220) # 1 = hole pixel pixArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().multiply(hole).rename('holeArea') # m² areaKm2 = pixArea.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('holeArea') return img.set('holeAreaKm2', ee.Number(areaKm2).divide(1e6)) # km² with_area = col.map(daily_area) areas = with_area.aggregate_array('holeAreaKm2').getInfo() valid = [a for a in areas if a is not None] if not valid: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") exit() maxArea = max(valid) print(f"2021 max hole area: {maxArea:.1f} million km²") # 4. Answer if abs(maxArea - 18) < 1.0: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -63])  # Antarctic polar region
year = 2021
start, end = f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31'

# 2. Data acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMAERUV003'). \
        filterDate(start, end).select('ColumnAmountO3'). \
        filterBounds(roi)
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No OMI images for 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Daily hole-area calculation (km²)
def daily_area(img):
    ozone = img.select('ColumnAmountO3')
    hole = ozone.lt(220)  # 1 = hole pixel
    pixArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().multiply(hole).rename('holeArea')  # m²
    areaKm2 = pixArea.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('holeArea')
    return img.set('holeAreaKm2', ee.Number(areaKm2).divide(1e6))  # km²

with_area = col.map(daily_area)
areas = with_area.aggregate_array('holeAreaKm2').getInfo()
valid = [a for a in areas if a is not None]
if not valid:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

maxArea = max(valid)
print(f"2021 max hole area: {maxArea:.1f} million km²")

# 4. Answer
if abs(maxArea - 18) < 1.0:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
